a1.text: I reinstall Windows on my cousin's laptop whenever it gets slow.
I keep the office wifi running and reset the router when the connection drops.
I check new versions of our online shop's app for bugs before they go live.
I put together a monthly sales report in Excel for my manager.
I record every payment and expense for our church in a ledger.
I write little Python programs that rename and sort hundreds of files at once.
I make sure my parents' phones have the latest updates and strong passwords.
I compare the prices of three suppliers before we buy flour for the bakery.
I teach my grandparents how to make video calls on their tablet.
I work out how much tax my mother's tailoring business owes each year.
I fix leaking taps and replace broken tiles in our flat.
I bake birthday cakes to order for the neighbours.
I mow lawns and trim hedges for the houses on my street.
I look after my neighbour's kids after school and help them with their homework.
I sell second-hand clothes online and answer buyers' questions.
I translate the church notices from English into Tamil.
I organised our class reunion: the venue, the food and the guest list.
I design posters for school events on Canva.
I check the stock in our family's grocery shop and order more when it runs low.
On weekends I drive a lorry and deliver furniture to customers' homes.
